question: Which of the following rivers originates from the Lahaul Valley of Himachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chenab River.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **River Chenab originates from the Lahaul valley of Himachal Pradesh, India.**
 
• **Chenab** is the** largest river** in **Himachal Pradesh** formed by the** two streams** named **Chandra and Bhaga. **
